counters.name: Instruction cache hit
counters.description: The percentage of read requests made that hit the data in the Instruction cache. The Instruction cache supplies shader code to an executing shader. Each request is 64 bytes in size. Value range: 0% (no hit) to 100% (optimal).

counters.name: Requests
counters.description: The number of read requests made to the Instruction cache. The Instruction cache supplies shader code to an executing shader. Each request is 64 bytes in size.

counters.name: Hits
counters.description: The number of read requests which result in a cache hit from the Instruction cache. The Instruction cache supplies shader code to an executing shader. Each request is 64 bytes in size.

counters.name: Misses
counters.description: The number of read requests which result in a cache miss from the Instruction cache. The Instruction cache supplies shader code to an executing shader. Each request is 64 bytes in size.

counters.name: Scalar cache hit
counters.description: The percentage of read requests made from executing shader code that hit the data in the Scalar cache. The Scalar cache contains data that does not vary in each thread across the wavefront. Each request is 64 bytes in size. Value range: 0% (no hit) to 100% (optimal).

counters.name: Requests
counters.description: The number of read requests made from executing shader code to the Scalar cache. The Scalar cache contains data that does not vary in each thread across the wavefront. Each request is 64 bytes in size.

counters.name: Hits
counters.description: The number of read requests made from executing shader code which result in a cache hit from the Scalar cache. The Scalar cache contains data that does not vary in each thread across the wavefront. Each request is 64 bytes in size.

counters.name: Misses
counters.description: The number of read requests made from executing shader code which result in a cache miss from the Scalar cache. The Scalar cache contains data that does not vary in each thread across the wavefront. Each request is 64 bytes in size.

counters.name: L0 cache hit
counters.description: The percentage of read requests that hit the data in the L0 cache. The L0 cache contains vector data, which is data that may vary in each thread across the wavefront. Each request is 128 bytes in size. Value range: 0% (no hit) to 100% (optimal).

counters.name: Requests
counters.description: The number of read requests made to the L0 cache. The L0 cache contains vector data, which is data that may vary in each thread across the wavefront. Each request is 128 bytes in size.

counters.name: Hits
counters.description: The number of read requests which result in a cache hit from the L0 cache. The L0 cache contains vector data, which is data that may vary in each thread across the wavefront. Each request is 128 bytes in size.

counters.name: Ray-box tests
counters.description: The number of ray box intersection tests.

counters.name: Write size
counters.description: The total bytes written to the video memory. This is measured with all extra fetches and any cache or memory effects taken into account.

counters.name: Misses
counters.description: The number of read requests which result in a cache miss from the L0 cache. The L0 cache contains vector data, which is data that may vary in each thread across the wavefront. Each request is 128 bytes in size.

counters.name: L2 cache hit
counters.description: The percentage of read or write requests that hit the data in the L2 cache. The L2 cache is shared by many blocks across the GPU, including the Command Processor, Geometry Engine, all WGPs, all Render Backends, and others. Each request is 128 bytes in size. Value range: 0% (no hit) to 100% (optimal).

counters.name: Requests
counters.description: The number of read or write requests made to the L2 cache. The L2 cache is shared by many blocks across the GPU, including the Command Processor, Geometry Engine, all WGPs, all Render Backends, and others. Each request is 128 bytes in size.

counters.name: Hits
counters.description: The number of read or write requests which result in a cache hit from the L2 cache. The L2 cache is shared by many blocks across the GPU, including the Command Processor, Geometry Engine, all WGPs, all Render Backends, and others. Each request is 128 bytes in size.

counters.name: Misses
counters.description: The number of read or write requests which result in a cache miss from the L2 cache. The L2 cache is shared by many blocks across the GPU, including the Command Processor, Geometry Engine, all WGPs, all Render Backends, and others. Each request is 128 bytes in size.

counters.name: Ray-triangle tests
counters.description: The number of ray triangle intersection tests.

counters.name: LDS Bank Conflict
counters.description: The percentage of GPUTime LDS is stalled by bank conflicts. Value range: 0% (optimal) to 100% (bad).

counters.name: Gpu Busy Cycles
counters.description: Number of GPU cycles that the GPU command processor was busy.

counters.name: LDS Busy Cycles
counters.description: Number of GPU cycles the LDS is stalled by bank conflicts. Value range: 0 (optimal) to GPUBusyCycles (bad).

counters.name: Memory unit busy
counters.description: The percentage of GPUTime the memory unit is active. The result includes the stall time (MemUnitStalled). This is measured with all extra fetches and writes and any cache or memory effects taken into account. Value range: 0% to 100% (fetch-bound).

counters.name: Memory unit stalled
counters.description: The percentage of GPUTime the memory unit is stalled. Try reducing the number or size of fetches and writes if possible. Value range: 0% (optimal) to 100% (bad).

counters.name: Memory unit busy cycles
counters.description: Number of GPU cycles the memory unit is active. The result includes the stall time (MemUnitStalledCycles). This is measured with all extra fetches and writes and any cache or memory effects taken into account.

counters.name: Memory unit stalled cycles
counters.description: Number of GPU cycles the memory unit is stalled.

counters.name: Write unit stalled
counters.description: The percentage of GPUTime the Write unit is stalled. Value range: 0% to 100% (bad).

counters.name: Write unit stalled cycles
counters.description: Number of GPU cycles the Write unit is stalled.

counters.name: Fetch size
counters.description: The total bytes fetched from the video memory. This is measured with all extra fetches and any cache or memory effects taken into account.

counters.name: Local video memory bytes
counters.description: Number of bytes read from or written to the Infinity Cache (if available) or local video memory

counters.name: PCIe bytes
counters.description: Number of bytes sent and received over the PCIe bus
